responsibility: This definition module supplies the GNU Modula-2 base library’s canonical ASCII control-character and delimiter constants, exporting named character codes such as nul, nl, cr, tab, del, and related aliases like lf, ff, eof, and EOL. It belongs to the low-level runtime support layer used throughout other gm2 libraries for text parsing, I/O, and string handling, and its only produced interface is a stable set of compile-time constants rather than executable logic.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the ASCII module pair: this file is the one that actually declares and assigns the exported character-code constants, whereas ASCII.mod is only an empty companion implementation body.
